cases.input: Reproduce an older Dr.-Komorowski report explicitly through the historical ReportLab direct-PDF path.
requiredBehaviors: preserve the historical ReportLab layout path and available vector assets
visually verify the rendered PDF page by page
forbiddenBehaviors: select the legacy renderer automatically for a new report
introduce a new fachliche interpretation while rendering

cases.input: A caller explicitly selects the legacy renderer, but the supplied report spec belongs to the new DOCX-first report model.
requiredBehaviors: recognize the incompatible new report specification
route the case to the canonical DOCX-first renderer path
avoid mixing modern DOCX template rules into historical ReportLab reproduction
forbiddenBehaviors: force an incompatible new report through the legacy renderer
silently modernize the legacy output path

cases.input: Historical brand assets are missing and the PDF render has visible defects, but a replacement logo could be invented to finish the legacy report.
requiredBehaviors: report missing historical assets instead of inventing replacement branding
reject a successful result while render defects remain
preserve the migration path to the canonical DOCX-first workflow
forbiddenBehaviors: invent corporate or brand assets to simulate historical fidelity
claim successful rendering before visual verification passes
